travel.musafirModeDesc: I am a traveller (musafir). Apply qasr to applicable prayers.
travel.musafirAlertBody:
Qasr (shortening) reduces Dhuhr, Asr, and Isha from 4 to 2 rakat.

Note: Jama (combining prayers) is not automatically applied due to scholarly differences. Please follow your local scholar or madhab regarding combining prayers during travel.
travel.fiqhNote: Fajr and Maghrib are not shortened (qasr applies to 4-rakat prayers only). Jama (combining prayers) requires following your local scholar or madhab ruling.
travel.recalcNote: Prayer times will be recalculated for your travel destination.
